name: Secret Fetch Test
shortDescription: Fetches a named secret via pipeline_sdk.env.get_secret() and reports whether it worked — proves the secret manager works inside a real running node
description: A minimal source node (no upstream input) that calls pipeline_sdk.env.get_secret(secretName) at run time and writes a small proof file: whether the fetch succeeded, the value's length, and a SHA-256 hash of the value. The real value is never written to any output file, and is not printed to the logs unless the demo switch below is turned on. Two demo switches show log masking: 'Print the real secret value to the logs' deliberately logs the value, and 'Turn OFF log masking' decides whether it appears as [REDACTED] (the default) or in plain text.

name.label: Name
name.description: Unique identifier for this node in the pipeline

secretName.label: Secret Name
secretName.description: Name of the secret to fetch from the Secret Manager (must match a name you stored in your profile menu's Secrets panel)

printSecretValue.label: Print the real secret value to the logs (demo)
printSecretValue.description: Demo only: deliberately logs the fetched secret value so you can see log masking at work. With masking on (the default) it shows [REDACTED]; with 'Turn OFF log masking' also on, the raw value appears in plain text in the run logs.

disableLogMasking.label: Turn OFF log masking (demo)
disableLogMasking.description: Leave off for normal use: the SDK then replaces any fetched secret with [REDACTED] in everything this node prints. Turn on only to show what an unmasked log looks like.

outputDescription: A JSON proof file: whether the secret was fetched, its length, and a hash — never the raw value
